snapshot.title: Ohio EPA DDAGW: Boil Water Advisory Mandate

transcript.speaker: DDAGW Liaison
transcript.text: This is the Ohio EPA DDAGW Liaison. We have received an emergency report from the Carver County Health Commissioner. The pressure in Zone 2 has dropped below 20 psi, and the chlorine residual at the Orchard Standpipe outlet has been confirmed at 0.0 mg/L.

transcript.speaker: DDAGW Liaison
transcript.text: Per Section 4.4 Level 3 of the MDWS-ERP-2026, you must issue a Boil Water Advisory within 30 minutes. The City Manager has been notified and will not approve any delay.

transcript.speaker: DDAGW Liaison
transcript.text: You must begin the advisory protocol immediately. The advisory must cover all customers in Zone 2 and parts of Zone 3 affected by the depressurized network. Confirm your action within 5 minutes.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject triggers the official Boil Water Advisory activation. The IC must declare Level 3, initiate the protocol per MDWS-PCP-2026, and assign roles to WQ and PIO. Watch for delays in protocol initiation or incorrect advisory type selection.
